notes: Modified cash basis school district; basic statements p1-4 (report pp7-10). Governmental statement p3 Total Governmental Funds column used for receipts/disbursements; roll-forward: 2,854,864 + 7,779,025 - 8,182,231 + 65,000 - 65,000 + 6,011,711 = 8,463,369 (ties). Beginning cash is the fund balance 'beginning of year' on p3; the nonmajor-to-major adjustment (44,732 / -44,732) nets to zero and is not listed. No business-type funds: School Nutrition is a governmental special revenue fund here. Attempt 3 (targeted re-check): State receipts 2,898,560 split using the fund schedules (General p6, Nutrition p12, Bond p13, Special Building p14, QCPUF p15; parts tie exactly) into homestead exemption 97,213, property tax credit 1,524,743, pro-rate motor vehicle 10,083 and state aid remainder 1,266,521; detail 1200/1291/1292 moved to Special Education Programs, 2410/2490 (printed under the 2300 heading) to School Administration, 3300 to Community Service Operations; 3535/3541/3551 stay Instruction (no state categorical heading; p5 counts them in Instruction). Attempt 4 (verifier fix 2026-10-28): School Nutrition 1620 Daily sales - non-reimbursable programs 10,300 is now School Lunch Sales (was reimbursements/refunds; the statement counts it in Nutrition program receipts 92,000); General Fund 1800 Community services activities 155,846 is now charges for services/fees, matching the Other local receipts statement line; the 645,000 budget of the printed Employee Benefit 2900 line is kept only on the spending part (other financing part budget null). Transfers: GF in 20,000 from Employee Benefit out 20,000; GF out 45,000 to School Nutrition in 45,000 (all tie). The p9 General Fund budget schedule prints 8000 transfers 45,000 inside Total disbursements 6,500,828, and p7 prints 5200 transfers in 20,000 inside Total receipts 6,420,251; both recorded as other financing in detail with includes. Detail: the General Fund budget schedule (pp6-9, by program code, no object breakdown so not itemized) is used for the General Fund; the p5 General Fund combining schedule (function level) is not repeated to avoid double counting. General Fund 2100 and 2200 header lines show budget only (236,591 and 189,403) with no actual, so they are not recorded. Budget column on split debt lines left null because the budget is printed for the combined line. Depreciation Fund (p10) had no actual receipts or spending (budget lines only). Activities Fund budget schedule (p17) is a one-line schedule; no per-account activities schedule is in the trimmed PDF. Receipts 'Other local receipts' 209,194 (p3) split (attempt 5) into its printed parts: General Fund 1740/1800/1920/1980/1990 (p6, column 174,486) and Other Governmental Funds Nutrition 1990 32,513 (p12) + Student Fee 1742 2,195 (p16) (column 34,708). Student Fee 2191 is support services (statement counts it in student support services). Read pages 1-17 of 17.
